scope: 25 ordinary humanoid sources from origin/main; Prayer and Echo are separate existing candidates. No encounter references changed.

preparation.method: Restore source triangle-corner UVs and original materials; keep generated bones and weights; normalize height/ground in standalone Unity prefabs. Images may be re-encoded.

reproduction.submit: RODIN_API_KEY in environment; python3 Tools/Hyper3DRigBatch.py. Private resumable state stays in ignored Logs. Archived jobs must not be resubmitted just to reproduce prepared models.
reproduction.prepare: Construct WORKDIR/specs.json from assets keyed by name with each source object; copy source files into sources/ and raw GLBs into raw/. Run blender -b --python Tools/PrepareHyper3DRigs.py -- WORKDIR NAME [NAME ...].
reproduction.import: Copy WORKDIR/outputs into Logs/AssetDesign/hyper3d-humanoids/prepared; use Unity CLI run_script Tools/Hyper3DRigImport.cs, entry Hyper3DRigImport.ImportValidate, args [comma-separated names].

validation.blender: 25/25: skeleton, normalized weights, matching geometry/UV transfer, no clips, reversible 3-degree chest deformation
validation.visual: Front/side/back neutral-pose contact sheets inspected. No missing body or material observed; source design choices retained.

remote_lfs_readback.method: Independent remote clone without shared local LFS storage; explicit git lfs pull; SHA-256 compared with manifest

validation.unity: 25/25 imported with 73 valid bones, zero AnimationClips, supported materials, target height and grounded feet, reversible 3-degree chest deformation.

limitations: Binding and neutral-pose inspection only; not acceptance of gameplay animation or target-device performance.
Current Unity glTFast import uses four bone influences per vertex; raw and prepared GLBs retain all influences.
Fused props, clothing, fingers and large motion ranges need character-specific validation after level/action design. No Avatar or retargeting acceptance.
